_README.description: Model metadata for X.AI (GROK) API access.
_README.usage: Models listed here are exposed directly through the X.AI provider. Aliases are case-insensitive.

field_descriptions.aliases: Array of short names users can type instead of the full model name
field_descriptions.context_window: Total number of tokens the model can process (input + output combined)
field_descriptions.max_output_tokens: Maximum number of tokens the model can generate in a single response
field_descriptions.max_thinking_tokens: Maximum reasoning/thinking tokens the model will allocate when extended thinking is requested
field_descriptions.supports_extended_thinking: Whether the model supports extended reasoning tokens (set from the provider's advertised reasoning support)
field_descriptions.supports_json_mode: Whether the model can guarantee valid JSON output
field_descriptions.supports_function_calling: Whether the model supports function/tool calling
field_descriptions.supports_images: Whether the model can process images/visual input
field_descriptions.max_image_size_mb: Maximum total size in MB for all images combined (capped at 40MB max for custom models)
field_descriptions.supports_temperature: Whether the model accepts temperature parameter in API calls (set to false for O3/O4 reasoning models)
field_descriptions.temperature_constraint: Type of temperature constraint: 'fixed' (fixed value), 'range' (continuous range), 'discrete' (specific values), or omit for default range
field_descriptions.use_openai_response_api: Set to true when the model must use the /responses endpoint (reasoning models like GPT-5.2 Pro). Leave false/omit for standard chat completions.
field_descriptions.default_reasoning_effort: Default reasoning effort level for models that support it (e.g., 'low', 'medium', 'high'). Omit if not applicable.
field_descriptions.intelligence_score: 1-20 human rating used as the primary signal for auto-mode model ordering. Since 2026-10-28 it is anchored to the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5 at HIGH reasoning effort (aa_index_by_effort['high'], leaderboard read 2026-10-28) through the v5 ladder in docs/model_ranking.md, which keeps the 1-20 scale of the earlier v4.3 ladder. Entries without aa_index_by_effort carry estimated scores; models that AA measured on v4.3 but not on v5 keep their v4.3-based scores. PAL tools default to thinking_mode medium, so a typical call can score a few Index points below the anchor.
field_descriptions.aa_index_by_effort: Optional per-effort Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index values (v5 leaderboard, read 2026-10-28), keyed by effort (non-reasoning, low, medium, high, xhigh, max; 'default' for a model with a single row). Values AA marks as incomplete (*) are left out.

models.description: Grok 4.7 (released 2026-09-21, 500K context) - xAI flagship for coding, agentic tasks and knowledge work, succeeding Grok 4.6; AA Intelligence Index v5 35 at high (31 at low, 34 at xhigh). $2/$6 per M.
GROK-4 (256K context) - Frontier multimodal reasoning model with advanced capabilities
GROK-4.1 Fast Reasoning (2M context) - High-performance multimodal reasoning model with function calling
